text: Rikki broke two more eggs. <break time="0.8s" /> And ran to the veranda. <break time="0.8s" /> With the last one in his mouth. <break time="0.8s" /> Teddy and his parents. <break time="0.8s" /> Were sitting at the breakfast table. <break time="0.8s" /> But they were not eating. <break time="0.8s" /> They sat as still as stones. <break time="0.8s" /> Because Nagaina was coiled up. <break time="0.8s" /> Near Teddys leg. <break time="0.8s" /> Son of the big man who killed Nag. <break time="0.8s" /> Stay still, she said. <break time="0.8s" /> I am not ready yet. <break time="0.8s" /> Turn round, Nagaina. <break time="0.8s" /> Turn and fight. <break time="0.8s" /> Cried Rikki. <break time="0.8s" /> Holding up the egg. <break time="0.8s" /> When Nagaina saw her last egg. <break time="0.8s" /> She turned away from Teddy. <break time="0.8s" /> At that moment. <break time="0.8s" /> Teddys father reached out. <break time="0.8s" /> And pulled his son to safety. <break time="0.8s" /> It was I. <break time="0.8s" /> Who caught Nag in the bathroom. <break time="0.8s" /> Said Rikki proudly. <break time="0.8s" /> Nagaina grabbed the egg. <break time="0.8s" /> And raced like an arrow. <break time="0.8s" /> To her hole. <break time="0.8s" /> And Rikki followed her inside. <break time="0.8s" /> Darzee thought. <break time="0.8s" /> That Rikki was dead. <break time="0.8s" /> But soon Rikki came out. <break time="0.8s" /> Covered in dirt. <break time="0.8s" /> It is all over, he said. <break time="0.8s" /> The widow. <break time="0.8s" /> Will never come out again. <break time="0.8s" /> From then on Rikki guarded the garden. <break time="0.8s" /> And no cobra ever dared. <break time="0.8s" /> To come inside its walls.
